summary.zh-CN: 禁用驱动多语句，用只读账号执行一条参数化 SELECT。
summary.en: Disable driver multi-statements and execute one parameterized SELECT with a read-only account.

details.zh-CN: 拒绝写操作、DDL 和存储过程，设置超时，并通过行数、单元格与输出字节上限约束结果。
details.en: Rejects writes, DDL and procedures, applies a timeout, and bounds results by row, cell and output-byte limits.

input_summary.zh-CN: 一条占位符参数化 SELECT 和位置参数数组。
input_summary.en: One placeholder-parameterized SELECT and positional parameter array.

output_summary.zh-CN: JSON-safe 字段对象行、读取计数、partial/checkpoint 与脱敏错误。
output_summary.en: JSON-safe field-object rows, read count, partial/checkpoint state and redacted error.

risk.zh-CN: 驱动必须关闭 multiStatements；数据库侧只读账号仍是最终安全边界。
risk.en: The driver must disable multiStatements; the database-side read-only account remains the final security boundary.

install_notes.zh-CN: 建议依赖：PyMySQL==1.1.1。复制模板不会安装依赖；请先选择兼容 Worker，再按平台依赖流程安装并核验来源。
install_notes.en: Suggested dependencies: PyMySQL==1.1.1. Copying the template does not install them; first select a compatible Worker, then install through the platform dependency flow and verify the source.

input_skeleton.sql: SELECT id, name FROM example_items WHERE updated_at >= %s

input_contract.driver_rule: one parameterized SELECT in a read-only transaction with multi-statements disabled and bounded streaming batches
input_contract.identifier_rule: identifiers are fixed in reviewed SQL, never interpolated from unvalidated input

output_contract.error: stable database_connection_failed or database_query_failed category only; no DSN, SQL parameters, driver message or password
output_contract.column_rule: duplicate column labels are rejected before any result row is published
output_contract.cell_encoding: decimals and unsafe integers use lossless strings; temporal values use ISO 8601 with the session fixed to UTC; UUID uses text; binary uses {$binary_base64: base64}
output_contract.checkpoint: row_offset is the count of complete JSON-safe rows already published

runtime_guidance.zh-CN: 模板复制后默认停止。为 python 选择兼容 Worker；Secret 键仅通过 Credential Binding 提供：MYSQL_DSN。使用数据库侧只读用户并保持 multiStatements 关闭；复制不会创建账号或安装驱动。
runtime_guidance.en: The copied template is stopped by default. Select a compatible python Worker. Secret keys are supplied only through Credential Binding: MYSQL_DSN. Use a database-side read-only user and keep multiStatements disabled; copying does not create accounts or install the driver.

install_notes.zh-CN: 建议依赖：mysql2@3.14.3。复制模板不会安装依赖；请先选择兼容 Worker，再按平台依赖流程安装并核验来源。
install_notes.en: Suggested dependencies: mysql2@3.14.3. Copying the template does not install them; first select a compatible Worker, then install through the platform dependency flow and verify the source.
